references.text: The fulfillment of the prophecy about 'the last days' - the star from Jacob and the scepter from Israel that will crush Moab
Jacob uses the same expression 'the last days' (בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים) when he prophesies about the future of his sons
Moses uses the expression 'the last days' (בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים) regarding Israel's future distress and repentance
Isaiah prophesies about what will happen to the Lord's house 'in the last days' (בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים)
Daniel receives a vision about what will happen to his people 'in the last days' (בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים)
Micah prophesies about 'the last days' (בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים) and the Lord's mountain
Balaam's advice to Balak led Israel into sin with Moabite women
John's Revelation refers to Balaam's teaching that led Israel to fall
